responsibility: Declares the legacy high-level GIMPLE builder helpers for creating assignment statements and type-cast assignments. The interface offers overloaded build_assign and build_type_cast entry points that hide temporary SSA-name creation and RHS construction details for simple statement synthesis.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declaration-only interface for the legacy build_assign and build_type_cast helper overloads, while the .cc file contains the actual temporary creation, type inference, and statement-construction logic.
